name: UNFUCK — whole-project ownership prompt
summary: A reusable prompt that gives one frontier agent accountable ownership of a whole project, paired with a one-page dispatch brief, the ranked God Questions with written falsifiers, eight machine-readable research contracts, and eleven agent skills for search, verification, classification and delegation.

evidence.summary: Public repository holds UNFUCK.md v3, templates/BRIEF.md, examples/, god-questions/ (ranked list with falsifiers, 8 Library contracts as JSON, July origins, 29 Aug binding example) and skills/ (11 SKILL.md packages); head commit read via the GitHub API immediately before this record was written.

license.reason: The prompt, brief, God Questions text and skills are SISO-authored and carry MIT.

evidence.summary: MIT license text is present at the exact release pin.

relationships.context: Curated under the Research section: the prompt is the reusable owner-of-record method and the God Questions are the ranked research agenda it draws on.

evidence.summary: The README presents the prompt, the God Questions and the skills as one source layer for a project owner.

relationships.context: The published god-questions/ folder is a public projection of the God Questions Observatory: the ranked list, falsifiers, and the eight contracts exported from this registry.

evidence.summary: Eight frontier-question JSON contracts are copied verbatim from registry/works with one private line scrubbed.

relationships.context: Eleven skills are republished from the Skills Hub and the owner's local skills in plain SKILL.md form; the Hub remains the canonical skill lifecycle.

evidence.summary: gitsearch, unified-code-search, xsearch, multisearch, skills-catalog, classify-by-reading, prove-before-claim and subagents come from the Hub registry; code-search-campaign, ui-bank and analyzing-video from the owner's skills.

relationships.context: The prompt is the whole-project ownership contract Agent Zero dispatches to project owners; the playbook holds the coordination side.

evidence.summary: UNFUCK.md names a routing agent (Main) that routes intent and is explicitly not an approval desk.

Version 3 of 5 September 2026: whole-project ownership, scepticism of inherited structure, source-authorship and decision-scoped supersession, verified agent entry point, distilled learning, explicit hard limits.
GQ-001 to GQ-019 ranked, with a falsifier and first worker-tier probe for GQ-011 to GQ-019; GQ-003 and GQ-007 are recorded as phantom or withheld.
Before publication the tree was scanned for owner name, local paths, private machine and network names, client names and credentials; none remain outside the LICENSE copyright line.
